title: Flatland
creator: Edwin A. Abbott
note: A square tries to describe a sphere. The diagrams make a surprisingly good companion to the first time you try to picture a fourth dimension.

title: A Trip to the Moon
creator: Georges Méliès
note: Watch the sets at the edges of the frame. Half the pleasure comes from seeing how much of the illusion fits on a small stage.

title: Gymnopédie No. 1
creator: Erik Satie
note: Follow the bass through the opening measures. Its slow, steady motion makes each small shift in the melody easier to hear.

title: Photochrom Prints
creator: Library of Congress
note: Start with a town you know and look for a surviving street corner. The prints make the colours of an earlier landscape feel almost within reach.
